questions.question_text: Why does Lomov visit Chubukov's house dressed in formal evening attire?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Lomov visits Chubukov's house to ask for the hand of Chubukov's 25-year-old daughter, Natalya Stepanovna, in marriage.

questions.question_text: How does Anton Chekhov satirize the marriage customs of Russian landed gentry in 'The Proposal'?
questions.marking_scheme_answer: Chekhov satirizes marriage as an economic property transaction motivated by land possessiveness, vanity, and greed rather than genuine romantic affection.
